values.note: 32 sites (001-034, no 011 or 017; 016 is ADA) plus a group site for up to 60, mid-May through September. 14 pull-throughs. Maximum vehicle lengths run 20-120 ft; only site 001 is under 25 ft. Gravel driveways.

values.note: Summer only: flush toilets and coin showers. Winter (Nov 1 - May 14): vault toilets and dump station only. Late 2026 drought notice: spigots, showers and flush toilets shut off, limited potable water at the visitor center; fill tanks before arriving.

facilities.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/sylvan-lake-state-park/sylvan-lake-state-park-camping-lodging ('Amenities include: ADA-accessible campsites, Vault toilets, Camper Services Building, Flush toilets (summer only), Coin-operated showers (summer only), Dump station, Water, Water spigots'; 'Winter amenities: Vault toilets, Dump station'; banner 'Water Shortage - Due to drought ... Water spigots, showers & flush toilets have been shut off ... we do have limited potable water available at the Visitor Center'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Reservation required: cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead; display a vehicle pass. Winter camping (Nov 1 - May 14) is first come, first served, paid at the self-serve station at the park entrance. 14 days in any 28; up to 6 people, 2 vehicles and one camping unit per site. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/sylvan-lake-state-park/sylvan-lake-state-park-camping-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at Sylvan Lake State Park ... online at cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613. values.note: Every Elk Run site $28 a night on cpwshop (2026-2027). Winter camping Nov 1 - May 14 is $10 a night, first come, paid at the entrance. Plus a CPW vehicle pass (daily $10-15) or annual pass. CPW's own table gives campsites as '$14 to $28'.

Status: CPW's camping page carries a drought notice: 'Due to drought, the park is experiencing a water shortage. The campground water system is spring fed & running very low. Water spigots, showers & flush toilets have been shut off ... we do have limited potable water available at the Visitor Center'. Campground open; recorded in facilities.note, not as a closure.
Road: CPW gives directions only ('Turn south on Brush Creek Road and travel nine miles ...'); no road-condition, RV or 4WD wording and no closure on the park pages.

Elk Run and Fisherman's Paradise are two loops of one park off the same park road by the visitor center: the nearest sites (Elk Run 001, Fisherman's Paradise 044) are ~70 m apart and the loop centroids ~230 m apart, with no separate entrance. Under the split rule (~1 km+, own entrance) they would be one entry; left as two for AWH to decide.
Elevation: stored values (2328 / 2320 m) were taken at the wrong pin; the loops are at ~8,500 ft (~2,590 m) per CPW. Re-fetch with the corrected pin.

Season: stored year_round false (derived from the old note 'Closed Nov-Apr') is not stated by CPW, whose page says 'Open to the public year-round' and 'Winter camping is available on a first-come, first-served basis ... November 1–May 14' without naming which loop stays open in winter. cpwshop still prints a $28 rate for Elk Run sites in January. Left as stored; ask CPW (970-328-2021) which loop is the winter loop.
Length: site 001 is listed 'Maximum Vehicle Length: 20' (driveway 30); every other site takes 25 ft or more. 120 ft at site 004 is the page's figure (driveway 120, pull-through).

Waterfront (stored not waterfront, kept): the old evidence ('~600 m north of the lake') was read at the wrong pin. At the real loop: Elk Run sits west and northwest of the Sylvan Lake dam, the lake beyond the dam embankment to the southeast (below the dam = no lake value), and no cpwshop site page carries a Proximity to Water tag. The outlet creek (West Brush Creek) runs in a willow strip along the loop's south edge, ~20-40 m from sites 031 and 034; its channel can't be seen under the willows, so creekside isn't confirmed.
Count: cpwshop lists 32 Elk Run sites + group; CPW says '44 Campsites' for the park (32 + 10 Fisherman's Paradise = 42, plus the group site and fishing shack). Stored 34 changed to 32.
